race.title: Midnite It's Actually Pretty Good Handicap (Div 1)
race.verdict: ENCORE had been going the right way prior to having excuses on her latest outing, so she is taken to bounce back to winning ways for her leading yard. Wise Crack gained reward for his consistency when scoring over C&D earlier this month and can remain competitive, with his old rival Noelies Dream also in the mix. ENCORE (FR) WISE CRACK (IRE) NOELIES DREAM
